exercises.title: Will — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci forma e usi essenziali di will senza trattarlo come futuro generico.
exercises.instructions: Collega will a previsione/opinione, decisione presa adesso e offerte/promesse chiare.

sections.title: Quando nasce la decisione?
sections.instructions: Prima capisci il significato, poi controlla will + verbo base.

questions.title: Will: non significa semplicemente futuro
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Osserva i contesti in cui will è naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Use will for predictions/opinions, instant decisions and clear offers/promises with correct form.

content.body: Will si costruisce con will + verbo base. È particolarmente utile per previsioni/opinioni, decisioni prese mentre parli e semplici offerte o promesse.
content.intro: Non partire da tomorrow: chiediti che cosa sta facendo il parlante con quella frase.

sections.title: La forma non cambia
sections.body: Dopo will il verbo resta sempre alla forma base.
sections.pattern: subject + will + base verb · subject + won't + base verb · Will + subject + base verb?

sections.title: Previsione o opinione
sections.body: Usa spesso will quando esprimi ciò che pensi succederà.

examples.text: I think the test will be difficult.

sections.title: Decisione presa adesso
sections.body: Se decidi cosa fare in risposta alla situazione presente, will è naturale.

examples.text: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
You're tired. I'll make some tea.

sections.title: Offerta o promessa
sections.body: Will può anche esprimere un'offerta o una promessa semplice.

examples.text: I'll carry that bag for you.

sections.title: Dopo will niente to e niente -s
Tre domande utili
points: È una previsione/opinione? → will può essere adatto.
È un'offerta o una promessa semplice? → will.
Dopo will usa sempre il verbo base.
Negativa: won't + verbo base; domanda: Will + soggetto + verbo base?

questions.title: Una decisione al momento
questions.prompt: A: This box is heavy. B: Don't worry, ___.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for an instant decision made while speaking.

feedback.explanation: B decide di aiutare in risposta al problema appena emerso: I'll help you.

questions.title: Controlla il verbo
questions.prompt: Correggi: Marta will goes with us.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after will.

feedback.explanation: Dopo will il verbo resta base: go.

questions.title: Negativa completa
questions.prompt: Completa la promessa.
questions.learning_objective: Build a negative will form with base verb.

feedback.explanation: Won't + base verb: won't tell.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a will question with correct order.

feedback.explanation: Will + soggetto + verbo base: Will your parents come with us?

questions.title: Un'opinione sul futuro
questions.prompt: I think our class ___ the competition.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for a future opinion/prediction.

feedback.explanation: I think introduce qui una previsione/opinione: will win.

exercises.title: Will — Allenati
exercises.description: Usa will in decisioni, previsioni, offerte, promesse, domande e negative.
exercises.instructions: Leggi il contesto: non scegliere will solo perché la frase parla del futuro.

sections.title: Usa will con uno scopo
sections.instructions: Le attività mescolano forma e intenzione comunicativa.

questions.title: Un problema improvviso
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Use will for an instant decision in dialogue.

turns.speaker: Luca
turns.text: I don't have enough cash either.

options.text: I pay for your ticket yesterday.
I'll to pay for your ticket.

feedback.explanation: Mia decide sul momento di pagare: I'll pay.

questions.title: Forme complete
questions.prompt: Complete with will or won't and the verb.
questions.learning_objective: Produce affirmative and negative will forms.

content.text_template: I think the weather [[blank_1]] (improve) tomorrow, but the temperature [[blank_2]] (not/rise) much.

feedback.explanation: Entrambe sono previsioni; il verbo dopo will/won't resta base.

questions.title: Una forma di troppo
questions.prompt: Correct: Will Anna to join us later?
questions.learning_objective: Correct a will question with an unnecessary to.

feedback.explanation: Will + Anna + join: niente to.

questions.title: Un'offerta concreta
questions.prompt: Your friend is carrying three heavy bags. What is the most natural thing to say?
questions.learning_objective: Use will for a spontaneous offer.

feedback.explanation: È un'offerta spontanea: I'll carry...

questions.title: Traduci la promessa
questions.prompt: Non lo dirò a nessuno.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a negative will promise.

feedback.explanation: Promessa negativa: I won't tell anyone.

questions.title: Una domanda sul futuro
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a natural will question.

feedback.explanation: When + will + the results + arrive?

questions.title: Quali forme sono corrette?
questions.prompt: Select all correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct affirmative, negative and question structures with will.

feedback.explanation: Dopo will/won't il verbo resta base anche nelle domande.

questions.title: Decisione e forma
questions.prompt: Complete the response.
questions.learning_objective: Combine instant-decision meaning with correct will form.

content.text_template: A: We're out of water. B: Okay, I [[blank_1]] [[blank_2]] some now.

feedback.explanation: La decisione nasce nella conversazione: will buy.

exercises.title: Will — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica will in formati tipici di una verifica scolastica.

sections.title: Verifica scolastica
sections.instructions: Non riceverai correzioni fino alla fine.

questions.title: Complete the sentences
questions.prompt: Complete with will or won't and the verb in brackets.
questions.learning_objective: Produce affirmative and negative will forms in school format.

content.text_template: 1. I think Mia [[blank_1]] (pass) the test. 2. Don't worry, I [[blank_2]] (not/forget) the tickets. 3. We [[blank_3]] (help) you with the boxes.

feedback.explanation: Controlla will/won't + verbo base.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: She will to send the email later.
questions.learning_objective: Correct an unnecessary to after will.

accepted_answers: She will send the email later.

feedback.explanation: Will + base verb: send.

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a will question in school format.

feedback.explanation: Where + will + you + stay?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Penso che sarà una giornata lunga.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a future opinion using will.

accepted_answers: I think it will be a long day.
I think it'll be a long day.

feedback.explanation: Opinione/previsione: I think it will be...

questions.title: Choose the best reply
questions.prompt: A: I can't open this jar. B: ___
questions.learning_objective: Recognise will for a spontaneous response in school-style choice.

feedback.explanation: Decisione presa in risposta al problema: I'll try.

questions.title: Complete the dialogue
questions.prompt: Choose the correct forms.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate will question and answer forms.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] you help me later? B: Yes, I [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Will you...? Yes, I will.

exercises.title: Will — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su significato, forma, domande, negative, decisioni e previsioni con will.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Decidi prima il significato, poi controlla la forma.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: The phone is ringing while you are cooking. What do you say?
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for an instant decision.

feedback.explanation: La decisione nasce adesso: I'll answer it.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Complete the two predictions.
questions.learning_objective: Produce affirmative and negative predictions with correct base forms.

content.text_template: I think the film [[blank_1]] (be) good, but it [[blank_2]] (not/win) an award.

feedback.explanation: Prediction: will be / won't win.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: He will arrives at six.
questions.learning_objective: Correct a conjugated verb after will.

feedback.explanation: Dopo will: arrive, non arrives.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a will information question independently.

feedback.explanation: What + will + you + do + next?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Ti aiuterò con i compiti, promesso.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a simple promise with will.

accepted_answers: I'll help you with your homework, I promise.
I will help you with your homework, I promise.

feedback.explanation: Promessa semplice: I'll help you...

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all grammatically correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate correct will structures across polarity and questions.

feedback.explanation: Will/won't è seguito dal verbo base.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a spontaneous offer with will.

turns.speaker: Nora
turns.text: I need to take them upstairs.

feedback.explanation: Ben offre aiuto sul momento: I'll carry one.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Complete the question and answer.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate will question and short answer structures.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] the teacher give us more time? B: I think she [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Will the teacher...? I think she will.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: Do you will need any help?
questions.learning_objective: Remove do from a will question and preserve base verb.

feedback.explanation: Will è già l'ausiliare: Will you need...?

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: You look at two possible outcomes and give your personal opinion. Which sentence fits best?
questions.learning_objective: Select will for an opinion-based prediction.

options.text: I think option B will work better.
I think option B will to work better.

feedback.explanation: È un'opinione sul risultato futuro: will work.

questions.title: Item 11
questions.prompt: Penso che non arriveranno in tempo. Li chiamerò adesso.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a prediction and an instant decision with correct will forms in one task.

accepted_answers: I think they won't arrive on time. I'll call them now.
I think they will not arrive on time. I will call them now.
I don't think they'll arrive on time. I'll call them now.

feedback.explanation: Prima previsione; poi decisione presa adesso: entrambe richiedono forma corretta con will.
